purpose: First evaluation of the frozen differential/tone detector on four previously unused complete scans, including a six-window tiling of each selected 120 ms visit. Numerical reference agreement is not independent Starlink truth.
selection_basis: Four newest complete qualified published scans in the read-only scanner history at selection time, chosen from capture metadata only. No quality scores or IQ were inspected for selection.
success_interpretation: Report first-window probe recall and association separately from visit-level evidence anywhere in the six-window tiling. Do not retune thresholds on this cohort, classify reference-negative RF as absent, or call six-window timing coverage a continuous detector.
